title: Head of Production
text:
**WHO WE ARE** 
At Ghirardelli, we honor tradition and drive innovation, aiming to be the top choice for premium chocolate. Our commitment to *Making Life A Bite Better* inspires both our products and the way we do business. We support personal and professional growth, recognizing that each employee’s contribution directly impacts Ghirardelli’s growth and success. Join our dynamic team and help shape Ghirardelli's future.

**Job Summary**

The Head of Production is accountable for safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-effective production across all three shifts of the factory. This role leads the production organization, establishes consistent operating standards and management routines across shifts, and ensures delivery of safety, food safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, waste, and people objectives.

The Head of Production translates factory strategy into clear production priorities, develops leadership capability throughout the production organization, creates the accountability required for sustained execution and deliver on key organizational metrics. The role partners and collaborates cross-functionally to resolve systemic losses, strengthen operating discipline, improve asset and labor performance, and embed TPM and continuous improvement practices into daily operations.

 

* Establish and sustain a culture of Safety and Food Safety, shifting the mindset to one of immediate intervention, learning, correction, and prevention of unsafe behaviors or conditions.
* Ensure production leaders visibly demonstrate safety and food-safety leadership on every shift
* Ensure timely containment, investigation, corrective action, and verification following significant incidents or deviations
* Partner with Safety and Quality to ensure standards are understood, implemented, audited, and sustained
* Ensure production readiness for internal, customer, and regulatory audits
* Lead, coach, and develop the production team to ensure clear expectations, accountability, and effective succession plans
* Establish consistent leadership expectations and operating discipline across all three shifts
* Ensure recognition, coaching, corrective action, and performance management are applied consistently across shifts
* Create an environment where standards are understood, leaders address deviations promptly, and follow-through is visible
* Identify systemic losses and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions are implemented
* Sponsor cross-functional improvement teams addressing systemic production losses
* Lead the AM pillar implementation into the culture and mindset of the factory
* Verify that corrective actions address root causes and prevent recurrence across applicable shifts and production areas
* Drive recovery plans when production performance deviates from plan
* Manage production spending, labor, overtime, material variances, and productivity commitments
* Ensure production capacity, labor capability, and operating constraints are represented in annual and long-term planning
* Partner with Maintenance and Reliability to align production plans, preventive maintenance, equipment access, shutdown execution, and chronic-loss elimination
* Partner with Planning and Warehouse to align production schedules, material availability, inventory requirements, and service priorities
* Partner with Quality to manage holds, deviations, and release priorities
* Partner with Engineering on design reviews, commissioning, qualifications, start-up, stabilization, and operational handoff of capital projects
* Partner with Training on workforce planning, leadership capability, and capability development plans
* Partner with HR and factory leadership on labor relations, grievance resolution, contract administration, negotiations, mediation, and arbitration, as required.
* Hire, develop and manage performance of team. Create an inclusive environment that embraces our values and purpose.
* Ensure reconciliation of production workorders and partner with finance function to reconcile and resolve any losses
* Partner with IP team for execution of projects to systematically reduce waste across processing and packaging streams
* Enable a proactive, positive, collaborative and engaged culture across all levels of the production organization
* Complete special projects and other duties as assigned or as necessary.

Minimum Education and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations management, food science, supply chain, business, or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience in a complex, multi-shift operation
* Experience leading managers and an organization with multiple levels of leadership
* Demonstrated accountability for safety, quality, service, cost, productivity and people results
* Experience in food, beverage, consumer packaged goods, or another regulated manufacturing environment
* Working knowledge of food-safety systems, manufacturing quality systems, and applicable regulatory requirements
* Experience applying Lean, TPM, or another structured continuous-improvement system
* Experience with labor planning, operating budgets, and performance management
* Ability to lead effectively in a union-represented environment

Other Job Requirements

* Regular presence in manufacturing and production areas is required
* Flexibility to work across all three shifts to provide leadership visibility, conduct reviews, coach leaders, and respond to operational needs.
* Availability outside of normal business hours for significant safety, food safety, quality, people, equipment, or service events
* Ability to operate in manufacturing environments involving noise, heat, cold, moving equipment, stairs, elevated areas, and required PPE
* Limited travel may be required for business meetings, training, supplier visits, benchmarking, or project support

Salary: $168766 to $219374

To learn more about our benefits visit Corporate Careers | Ghirardelli, and select "Learn More" under Corporate, Manufacturing or Restaurant & Retail.

Ghirardelli's salary range reflects market rates based on our size, revenue, and location. Starting pay is determined using a wide range of factors including, but not limited to, job-related skills, knowledge, and experience as well as market conditions. A bonus and/or long-term incentive may be included as part of this compensation package.

Ghirardelli is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, age, veteran status, or any other classification protected by state, local or federal law. Where permitted by law, applicants for this position may be required to undergo job‑related background and drug screening. Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with relevant state and local fair chance laws, including the California Fair Chance Act and the New York City Fair Chance Act, where applicable.
